function.name: agent
function.description:
Launch a subagent to handle a task autonomously. Choose the lightest subagent type that can accomplish the task.

- **explore**: Read-only. Code search, finding definitions, tracing call chains.
- **plan**: Read-only. Design implementation plans, analyze tradeoffs.
- **general_purpose**: Full access. Write code, run builds, execute tests.
- **computer_use**: Isolated GUI automation. Runs in a dedicated VM and may open apps, move the mouse, and send keys.
- **external**: Dispatch to an external coding agent (Claude Code, Codex). Requires agent_name parameter.

Do not call this tool more than once for the same task — one agent per task is sufficient.

subagent_type.description: The subagent execution strategy. Use 'explore' for read-only code search, 'plan' for read-only planning, 'general_purpose' for full tool access, 'computer_use' for isolated GUI automation.

prompt.description: A detailed description of the task for the subagent to perform. Include all necessary context — the subagent does not see the current conversation history.

agent_name.description: Name of the external agent to use. Required when subagent_type is 'external'. Currently supported: 'claude_code'.

plan_first.description: If true (default), the external agent plans before implementing. The plan is reviewed before execution begins. Set to false for simple tasks that don't need planning.
